messages:
dana.h: Heads up — drafting the release notes and internal announce for next week's optimizer + serving runtime rollout. Need to lock the internal announce time and fallback lanes. Target change window: Tue 2026-04-14 02:00-05:00 UTC. Please confirm availability.

liam: Tue window works for infra. Can we set a hard stop at 03:30 for the riskier optimizer changes? If not, we'll need a clear rollback trigger.

dana.h: Hard stop at 03:30 noted. Plan A: staged canary (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with 15-min holds. Plan B: immediate rollback to v1.12 if latency >150ms p95 or error rate >1% :warning:

emma: Ops needs the model pin added to the RN and the internal blurb. Suggest pinning canary to `redwood-opt:v2.0-quant` and fallback to `v1.12`.

sam: Ack — i'll add the pin and a quick rollback command to the RN draft. Snippet to include:
```
# rollback to safe model
redwood deploy --model redwood-opt:v1.12 --force --region eu-west-1
```

release-bot: Deploy job queued by @dana.h — job id 54321, canary policy=staged, timeout=45m. Logs will post to #eng-releases and #eng-sre.

ops-oncall: i'll be on standby for the window. please set oncall alerting to critical-only and page if canary fails or latency breach persists beyond 2 consecutive holds.

qa-automation: regression suite is queued. Running smoke first, then perf. If perf regression triggers, we'll flag immediately in #eng-sre and hold rollout.

dana.h: Draft internal announce (short):
"Planned maintenance: optimizer changes + serving runtime updates on Tue 02:00-05:00 UTC. Brief impact: possible 1–2 minute request spikes during canary windows. We will automatically roll back if SLOs are breached. Ops & SRE on standby"

liam: add a line: "Dedicated customers with pinned deployments will not be auto-updated; account teams will be notified separately." Also link to rollback playbook.

dana.h: Good catch, added. Final ask: marketing & sales — please DO NOT send external comms until internal announce goes out at 01:00 UTC same day. @emma please confirm you'll post internal message.

emma: Confirmed. I'll post internal announce at 01:00 UTC and ping sales slack. :thumbsup:

sam: Release notes updated and pushed at docs/release-notes/2145678901-rn.md. Sent for quick eng-docs lint.

dana.h: Thanks — scheduling deploy bot for 02:00 UTC. If anything changes before then i'll update this thread. :shipit:
